# Nxtlvl Social

> Nxtlvl Social is a creative and automation studio for small businesses. It designs social media posts, edits reels and short videos, builds websites, publishes on schedule and automates the replies. Every piece is finished by a designer. Packages are quoted after a free 15-minute call; no contracts, and you own every file.

## Packages

- [Content & Design](https://nxtlvlsocial.ai/social-media-design): Instagram and Facebook posts, carousels, story sets, posters, menus, price lists, festival and offer creatives, captions and hashtags, brand kit set up in week one. First drafts the same day or next day.
- [Video & Editing](https://nxtlvlsocial.ai/reel-editing): Reels and YouTube Shorts, product and talking-head videos, cut with subtitles, hooks, motion graphics and covers, from phone footage or none. First drafts within 48 hours. Includes everything in Content & Design.
- [Social + Automation](https://nxtlvlsocial.ai/social-media-automation): we plan, make and publish the calendar, answer common DM and comment questions, route every enquiry to the owner, run an on-site shoot and send a monthly report on the 1st. Includes everything in the packages above.
- [Website Development](https://nxtlvlsocial.ai/website-development): fast, mobile-first websites and landing pages designed in the brand kit, set up for Google and AI search, with booking or enquiry forms and updates after launch.

## Key facts

- Pricing: every package is quoted after a free 15-minute call; the number is agreed before work starts and does not change mid-month.
- No contract, no lock-in. Change package or stop at the end of any month.
- AI makes first drafts and variants; a designer finishes every piece. Nothing is posted until the owner approves it.
- Final and source files, including the brand kit, belong to the client.
- Who it is for: cafés and restaurants, salons and spas, gyms and studios, boutiques and retail, clinics and dentists, real estate, coaching centres, auto services, home bakers, photographers, hotels, yoga and wellness.
- Where: online, for businesses across India; on-site shoots within the service area.
- Contact: connect@nxtlvlsocial.ai. Start with a free 15-minute call.
